description: This file defines a React class component named 'PanelResizer' which provides resizable panel functionality, including drag-and-drop resizing and double-click to collapse/expand, with support for different resize types and sides.

classes.name: PanelResizer
classes.description: A React component enabling resizable panels with drag-and-drop and double-click collapse features, managing state and DOM manipulations for panel resizing.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the panel, ensuring constraints such as minimum and maximum are respected, and optionally finishes the resize operation.

methods.name: setLeft
methods.description: Sets the left position of the panel element.

methods.name: onDblClick
methods.description: Handles double-click to toggle panel collapse/expand state.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Handles the resize event, recalculating width based on current layout.

methods.name: onMouseDown
methods.description: Initiates resize operation by adding overlay and recording initial state.

methods.name: onMouseUp
methods.description: Completes resize operation, triggers callbacks, and removes overlay.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles the mouse movement during resize, updating width or left depending on side.
